embeds.title: PSBL INJURY REPORT
embeds.description: Injury updates across MLB. Stories are posted by automation as a headline, a source name and a direct link. Full articles are never copied; open the link to read the source.

fields.name: POSTED HERE
fields.value: New injuries • Day-to-day updates • Injured list placements, transfers and activations (10, 15 and 60-day) • Surgeries and rehab assignments • Returns

fields.name: OWNER ALERTS
fields.value: The wire checks injury stories against PSBL rosters. An owner who has opted in is mentioned when one of their own players appears, and only for their own players.

fields.name: MAJOR INJURIES
fields.value: A season-ending or indefinite injury may be posted in **🚨│breaking-news** instead.
